query: INSERT INTO oidc_sign_in_attempts (session_id, state_digest, pkce_verifier, nonce, expires_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, now() + interval '15 minutes') ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET state_digest = EXCLUDED.state_digest, pkce_verifier = EXCLUDED.pkce_verifier, nonce = EXCLUDED.nonce, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
